article_content: Historical analysis reveals British military forces engaged with nearly 90% of the world's nations through invasions, occupations, or negotiated agreements. Stuart Laycock's study, compiled in 'All the Countries We've Ever Invaded,' documents interventions ranging from Roman-era incursions into Gaul to WWII operations in Iceland. Of 200 nations analyzed, only 22—including Luxembourg and Pacific island states—remained untouched. The research methodology counts formal military actions, state-sanctioned piracy, and coercive negotiations. Laycock initiated the project after his son questioned Britain's imperial reach, uncovering surprising historical episodes like the 1940 occupation of neutral Iceland with 745 marines. While presenting comprehensive data, the author clarifies this as historical documentation rather than moral critique, noting France as another nation with extensive military history.
translated_content: Istrazivanje otkriva da je Britanija kroz istoriju imala vojno prisustvo u gotovo 90% svetskih drzava. Studija Stjuarta Lejkoka iz knjige 'Sve zemlje koje smo ikada napali' dokumentuje intervencije – od rimskih pohoda u Galiju do okupacije Islanda 1940. Od 200 analiziranih nacija, samo 22 (ukljucujuci Luksemburg i pacificke ostrvske drzave) nisu dozivele britanske upade. Metodologija obuhvata vojne akcije, drzavno odobreno piratstvo i prisilne pregovore. Lejkok je zapoceo istrazivanje nakon sto ga je sin pitao o istoriji imperije, otkrivajuci iznenadujuce slucajeve poput okupacije neutralnog Islanda sa 745 marinaca. Iako prikazuje opsezne podatke, autor istice da je ovo istorijski zapis a ne moralna osuda, spominjuci Francusku kao drugu naciju sa znacajnom vojnom istorijom.

article_content: Launching November 14th for a four-week run, London's Deluxe pop-up restaurant combines culinary mystery with festive flavors. Diners experience a 'concept revelation' post-meal alongside signature dishes like smoked reindeer with pickled blackberries and mascarpone. The ever-changing menu also highlights lobster tagliatelle with truffle oil and crowd-voted weekly specials. Open Wednesday-Sunday in Spitalfields' Ely's Yard, the establishment hosts free Tuesday wine tastings while donating food/drink profits to CLIC Sargent's childhood cancer programs. A Michelin-starred consultant contributes expertise, though organizers stress that quality dining doesn't require starred credentials. When doors close December 14th, all recipes become publicly available for home cooks to recreate the experience.
translated_content: U londonskom Spitalfildsu počinje 14. novembra ograničeni gastronomski pop-up pod nazivom Deluxe, koji će mesec dana kombinovati kulinarsku misteriju sa božićnim aromama. Gosti otkrivaju koncept restorana tek na kraju obroka, uz specijalitete poput dimljenog soba sa kiselim kupinama i mascarponeom. Meni uključuje i jastogovu tagliatelle sa tartuf uljem, sa novim jelima koje nedeljno biraju gosti putem društvenih mreža. Radnim danima od srede do nedelje u Ely's Yard-u, restoran donira deo zarade fondaciji CLIC Sargent za borbu protiv dečjeg raka. Uz besplatne vinske degustacije utorkom, tim savetuje se sa Michelinovim šefom, ističući da vrhunska hrana ne zahteva zvezde. Svi recepti postaju javni nakon zatvaranja 14. decembra, pozivajući ljubitelje kuhanja na kućnu reinterpretaciju.
